questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains an error.
Shall have / you bring / your note-book / tomorrow?
questions.solution: C)'Shall have' के बदले 'Shall' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'Shall have' का प्रयोग भविष्य में पूर्ण हो चुकी क्रियाओं के लिए किया जाता है (Future Perfect Tense), जबकि यहां प्रश्न का स्वरूप सामान्य भविष्य की योजना या अनुरोध को व्यक्त कर रहा है। सही संरचना होगी: "Shall you bring your note-book tomorrow?" जिसमें 'Shall' एक सामान्य भविष्य के प्रश्न के लिए उपयुक्त है; जैसे— Shall you bring your note-book tomorrow?

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.
The chief guest gave out prizes to the meritorious students of the school
questions.solution: A) 'gave out prizes' के बदले 'gave away prizes'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'give out' का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ का वितरण करना या कुछ समाप्त हो जाना, जबकि यहां संदर्भ है पुरस्कारों का वितरण करना, जिसके लिए 'give away' सही phrase है। 'Give away' का अर्थ है किसी चीज़ को मुफ्त में देना या पुरस्कार वितरित करना। अतः 'gave away prizes' सही विकल्प है; जैसे— The chief guest gave away prizes to the meritorious students of the school.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
The manager noticed / that Pragya / was first to reach / the office on Saturday
questions.solution: B)'was first to reach' के बदले 'was the first to reach'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'the first' का प्रयोग यह दिखाने के लिए किया जाता है कि कोई व्यक्ति या वस्तु किसी समूह में सबसे पहले है। यहाँ 'Pragya' की बात हो रही है जो सबसे पहले कार्यालय पहुंची, इसलिए 'the' का प्रयोग आवश्यक है। अतः 'was the first to reach' सही विकल्प है; जैसे— The manager noticed that Pragya was the first to reach the office on Saturday.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
Mathematics help/ in developing/ the logical mindset /of students
questions.solution:
B)‘help' के बदले'helps'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि ‘Mathematics’ Singular Noun है; जैसे— Mathematics helps in developing the logical mindset of students.
'helps'will be used instead of 'help' because ‘Mathematics’ is a Singular Noun; Like— Mathematics helps in developing the logical mindset of students.

Father took the newspaper / in his hand to / go through it once again.
questions.solution: A)No error

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
When Serena / will arrive, / she will / call you.
questions.solution: D)'will arrive' के बदले 'arrives' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि Conditional Sentences में यदि मुख्य clause Future Tense में है, तो 'When' से शुरू होने वाले clause में Present Tense का प्रयोग होता है। जैसे— When Serena arrives, she will call you.

questions.question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.
He do not / fear the / repercussions of / this decision.
questions.solution: A)He do not' के बदले'He does not'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि Subject (He) Singular है और Singular Subject के साथ 'do' का प्रयोग सही नहीं है, अत: 'does' का प्रयोग सही होगा; जैसे— He does not fear the repercussions of this decision.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
It is his job / to chase out / clients with / outstanding debts
questions.solution:
A)'to chase out' के बदले 'to chase away'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'chase away' का अर्थ होता है किसी को या किसी चीज़ को भगाना या दूर करना। 'chase out' का अर्थ अधिकतर किसी स्थान से निकालने के संदर्भ में होता है, जो यहाँ वाक्य में उचित नहीं है। जैसे— It is his job to chase away clients with outstanding debts.
'to chase away'will be used instead of 'to chase out' because 'chase away' means to drive someone or something away, which is more appropriate in this context. 'chase out' usually refers to physically forcing someone out of a place, which doesn't fit well in this sentence. Like— It is his job to chase away clients with outstanding debts

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into three segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If you don’t find any error, select ‘No error’ as your answer.
It was possible to achieve anything, / if one has the grit and determination / to keep going.
options: 1) if one has the grit and determination
2) It was possible to achieve anything,
questions.solution:
B) ‘was' के बदले'is'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'if one has the grit and determination' और 'to keep going' Present Tense में हैं अत: मुख्य Clause में भी Verb Present Tense में होगा; जैसे— It is possible to achieve anything if one has the grit and determination to keep going.
'is'will be used instead of 'was' because 'if one has the grit and determination' and 'to keep going' are in Present Tense, so the main Clause should also have the Verb in Present Tense; Like— It is possible to achieve anything if one has the grit and determination to keep going.

questions.question:
Identify the error in the tense of the sentence and select the option that correctly rectifies the error.
Between two evils, I always picks the one I have never tried before
options: 1) Between two evils, I always is picking the one I have never tried before.
2) Between two evils, I always picking the one I have never tried before.
3) Between two evils, I always pick the one I have never tried before.
4) Between two evils, I always picked the one I have never tried before.
questions.solution:
C) Between two evils, I always pick the one I have never tried before.
'picks' के बदले 'pick' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि Subject 'I' के साथ Simple Present Tense में Verb की Base Form का प्रयोग होता है। यहां "I always pick" एक सामान्य आदत या प्रवृत्ति को व्यक्त कर रहा है, इसलिए Verb 'pick' होना चाहिए; जैसे— "I always pick the best option available."
'pick' will be used instead of 'picks' because with the subject 'I,' the base form of the verb is used in the Simple Present Tense. Here, "I always pick" expresses a general habit or tendency, so the verb should be 'pick'; Like— "I always pick the best option available."

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
My Vice-Chancellor works / eighteen hours / a day, / seven days week.
questions.solution: B) The article "a" is used before a singular countable noun, which is why "a week" should be used. In the phrase "seven days a week," the word "week" is a singular countable noun, and the article "a" indicates that this activity happens once within the time frame of a week.

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.
Mumbai is the city of dreams but it is a expensive city too
questions.solution: B)‘a expensive city too' के बदले'an expensive city too'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'expensive' शब्द एक vowel sound (अ से उच्चारित) से शुरू होता है, अत: इसके पहले 'an' का प्रयोग होता है; जैसे— Mumbai is an expensive city.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
The teacher will / certainly help you / if you will / ask her.
questions.solution:
B) 'if you will' में error है क्योंकि Conditional Clauses में, Simple Future Tense के बजाय Present Tense का प्रयोग किया जाता है। "if" Clause में भविष्य की घटनाओं के लिए Present Simple Tense का उपयोग करना चाहिए; जैसे— "If you ask her, she will help you."
The error is in 'if you will' because in Conditional Clauses, the Present Tense is used instead of the Simple Future Tense. The "if" clause should use the Present Simple Tense for future events; Like— "If you ask her, she will help you."

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.
She was fond of walking along the path besides the lake.
questions.solution: A)'besides' के बदले'beside'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'beside' का अर्थ होता है 'के पास' या 'के किनारे' और 'besides' का अर्थ होता है 'के अतिरिक्त'; जैसे— She was fond of walking along the path beside the lake.

questions.question:
Rectify the sentence by selecting the correct spelling from the options.
Psycology developed as a significant discipline of study in the twentieth century
questions.solution: A) The correct spelling of ‘Psycology’ is ‘Psychology’which means “the scientific study of the human mind and its functions, especially those affecting behavior in a given context” मनोविज्ञान.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
The manager asked / the cooking team, “Who / among you is to baked the / Christmas cake this year?”
options: 2) among you is to baked the
questions.solution:
B) 'among you is to baked the' में error है क्योंकि 'is to baked' का प्रयोग गलत है। सही रूप "is to bake" होना चाहिए, क्योंकि "is to" के बाद Verb की Base Form (Infinitive) का प्रयोग होता है। जैसे— "Who among you is to bake the cake this year?"
The error is in 'among you is to baked the' because 'is to baked' is incorrect. The correct form should be "is to bake" as "is to" is followed by the base form of the verb (Infinitive). Like— "Who among you is to bake the cake this year?"

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains an error.
Geeta was working now but she can be seen swimming in the river every evening
questions.solution:
C) ‘was working now' के बदले'is working now'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'now' Present Tense को दर्शाता है अत: 'is working now' का प्रयोग होगा; जैसे— Geeta is working now but she can be seen swimming in the river every evening.
'is working now' will be used instead of 'was working now' because 'now' indicates Present Tense, so 'is working now' will be used; Like— Geeta is working now but she can be seen swimming in the river every evening.

questions.question:
The following sentence has been divided into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.
The new / secretary / does not likes / me.
questions.solution:
A) does not likes' के बदले'does not like'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'does' के साथ Verb की base form का प्रयोग होता है; जैसे— He does not like apples.
'does not like' will be used instead of 'does not likes' because with 'does', the base form of the verb is used; Like— He does not like apples.

questions.question:
Parts of the following sentence have been given as options. Select the option that contains a spelling error.
I was alarmed lest we should be wreked
questions.solution:
B) 'wreked' के बदले'wrecked'का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'wreked' गलत spelling है; जैसे— The ship was wrecked in the storm.
'wrecked' will be used instead of 'wreked' because 'wreked' is a spelling error; Like— The ship was wrecked in the storm.

questions.question:
Identify the error in the following sentence and select the option with the correct use of the phrasal verb.
The police inspector was trying to give out the contradicting stories in the scene of the accident
options: 1) The police inspector was trying to sort out the contradicting stories in the scene of the accident.
2) The police inspector was trying to sign up the contradicting stories in the scene of the accident.
3) The police inspector was trying to rush out the contradicting stories in the scene of the accident.
4) The police inspector was trying to lighten up the contradicting stories in the scene of the accident.
questions.solution:
A)The police inspector was trying to sort out the contradicting stories in the scene of the accident.
'give out' के बदले 'sort out' का प्रयोग होगा क्योंकि 'give out' का अर्थ है 'बाँटना' जबकि यहाँ सही phrasal verb 'sort out' है जिसका अर्थ है 'समस्याओं का समाधान करना'। वाक्य में पुलिस इंस्पेक्टर विरोधाभासी कहानियों को सुलझाने की कोशिश कर रहा है, इसलिए 'sort out' सही phrasal verb है; जैसे—The police inspector was trying to sort out the contradicting stories in the scene of the accident.
'sort out' will be used instead of 'give out' because 'give out' means 'to distribute,' whereas the correct phrasal verb here is 'sort out,' which means 'to resolve issues.' In the sentence, the police inspector is trying to resolve the contradicting stories, so 'sort out' is the appropriate phrasal verb; Like—The police inspector was trying to sort out the contradicting stories in the scene of the accident.
